csvOutput.title: CSV Output
csvOutput.description: Single-table CSV of the opportunities that moved, with columns Bucket (UPSIDE or SLIPPAGE), OpportunityId, OpportunityName, RawValue, CurrencyIsoCode, MovementPhrase, and NextStep. OpportunityId is the 18-char id and joins to Get_Opportunity_Snapshot / Get_Opportunity_Score on Id = OpportunityId. Upside rows come first, then slippage; both are already ranked and capped at 3. This is intermediate data, NOT the reply: the Forecasting Specialist MUST transform it into the Key Pipeline Shifts block described in Case [WEEKLY_DIGEST] Step C2. Never show this raw CSV to the user.
